## Bug report

**Required Info:**

- **Operating System:** Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS (aarch64)
- **Computer:** ASUS Zenbook A16 (Snapdragon X2 Elite arm64 Processor) - Kernel 7.3.0-6-generic
- **ROS2 Version:** Lyrical binaries, Nav2 built from source, head revision (**Compiled with Debug, running on GCC 15.x**)
- **Version or commit hash:**  [5eb90caf (main)](https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/commit/5eb90caf7b128e77763248f1d416fe2e7099a664) 
- **DDS implementation:**  rmw_zenoh_cpp

#### Steps to reproduce issue
<!-- Detailed instructions on how to reliably reproduce this issue http://sscce.org/
``` code that can be copy-pasted is preferred ``` -->

Problem occurs when point cloud is empty (e.g. filtered out through `min_obstacle_height` / `max_obstacle_height`) 
When the code iterates on the empty point cloud:
 - Goes unnoticed if nav2_costmap_2d is built with Release, RelWithDebInfo... (optimized) builds. 
 - But crashes when built with `_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS` enabled.
 
GCC 15 now enables these assertions by default in Debug (unoptimized) builds, so runtime checks catch this invalid use.
Ref: [Debug assertions are now enabled by default for unoptimized builds. Use -D_GLIBCXX_NO_ASSERTIONS to override this.](https://gcc.gnu.org/gcc-15/changes.html)

With the TurtleBot 4 simulation, in a clean workspace:

```bash
# clean workspace with navigation2 main (5eb90caf at the time of writing)
mkdir -p nav2_costmap_crash_ws/src && cd nav2_costmap_crash_ws
git clone https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2.git src/navigation2
rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -y

# Debug build (GCC 15 enables libstdc++ assertions at -O0)
colcon build --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
source install/setup.bash

# stock params, plus min_obstacle_height above the lidar for the local costmap's scan source,
# so the height filter leaves every scan without points
cp src/navigation2/nav2_bringup/params/nav2_params.yaml nav2_params_empty_scan.yaml
sed -i '/^local_costmap:/,/^global_costmap:/ s/^\(          \)max_obstacle_height: 2.0$/&\n\1min_obstacle_height: 1.0/' nav2_params_empty_scan.yaml

# the container with the local costmap aborts as soon as the first scan arrives
ros2 launch nav2_bringup tb4_simulation_launch.py headless:=True use_rviz:=False params_file:=$PWD/nav2_params_empty_scan.yaml
```

#### Expected behavior
Run, without crashing, even if assertions are enabled.

#### Actual behavior
Crashes the node when PointCloud is empty. Crash log and extracted stack trace below:

```
/usr/include/c++/15/bits/stl_vector.h:1346: constexpr std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>::reference std::vector<_Tp, _Alloc>::front() [with _Tp = unsigned char; _Alloc = std::allocator<unsigned char>; reference = unsigned char&]: Assertion '!this->empty()' failed.
[ERROR] [component_container-8]: process has died [pid ..., exit code -6, ...]
```

```
#5  rosidl::Buffer<unsigned char>::front()                   rosidl_buffer/buffer.hpp:212
#6  sensor_msgs::impl::PointCloud2IteratorBase(cloud, "x")   sensor_msgs/impl/point_cloud2_iterator.hpp:261
#9  nav2_costmap_2d::VoxelLayer::updateBounds                nav2_costmap_2d/plugins/voxel_layer.cpp:201
#10 nav2_costmap_2d::LayeredCostmap::updateMap               nav2_costmap_2d/src/layered_costmap.cpp:173
#12 nav2_costmap_2d::Costmap2DROS::mapUpdateLoop             nav2_costmap_2d/src/costmap_2d_ros.cpp:569
```
